errors.text_span: with each model showing three bars representing different SFT configurations
errors.evidence: Each model group contains four bars, not three. The description incorrectly separates the "no SFT" bar from the other three "SFT configurations".
According to the legend, the "+ SFT on D₀" bars are yellow-orange with horizontal stripes, not pale blue. The pale blue bars represent "no SFT".
According to the legend, the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" bars are purple with diagonal stripes, not light pink. The light pink/peach bars represent "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂".

errors.text_span: "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" (medium pink-purple)
errors.evidence: According to the legend, the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" bars are solid pink/peach, not medium pink-purple. The purple bars represent "+ SFT on D₀, D₁".

errors.text_span: a single bar for "no SFT" (yellow-orange) for each model
errors.evidence: According to the legend, the "no SFT" bars are pale blue with diagonal stripes, not yellow-orange. The yellow-orange bars represent "+ SFT on D₀".

errors.text_span: The "no SFT" bars for "LLaMA-2-7B", "LLaMA-2-13B" and "LLaMA-2-70B" have approximate values of 22%, 25% and 27% respectively.
errors.evidence: The actual values for the "no SFT" bars (the pale blue, diagonally striped ones) are approximately 66%, 70%, and 81%, respectively. The values reported in the description are drastically incorrect.

errors.text_span: The pink-purple bars representing "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" tend to have the greatest values in each group
errors.evidence: This statement is only true for the LLaMA-2-7B model group. For both the LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B groups, the purple striped bar ("+ SFT on D₀, D₁") is taller than the solid pink/peach bar ("+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂"). Therefore, the generalization is incorrect for two of the three groups.

The description fails to mention that three of the four bar types have distinct striped patterns (diagonal or horizontal), which is a key visual feature used to differentiate them in addition to color.
